version.changelog: 移除外部技能依赖，增加 NVIDIA Skill Card，明确浏览器填报前提条件

llm.summary: This is a disclosed document-generation helper for Chinese software copyright filings, but users should review the generated source-code documents and form text before using them.

dimensions.detail: The skill’s file reading, DOCX/Markdown generation, and optional guided browser filing are coherent with software copyright registration; the sensitive output may include source code and legal filing text, so user review matters.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow asks for user confirmation before optional online filing and explicitly forbids automatic submission, but the form-info script can fill sparse README-derived sections with generic text that may need correction.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains a SKILL.md and three Python scripts; no installer, background service, hidden persistence, or bundled binary was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Recursive scanning of a user-supplied source directory and writing output files is purpose-aligned, but users should run it on a prepared project copy and confirm excludes to avoid including secrets, dependencies, or unrelated files.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No credential storage, privilege escalation, startup persistence, destructive behavior, or automatic network exfiltration was found; optional browser use is user-confirmed and directed at the stated registration site.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing or using, point it only at the intended project directory, exclude secrets and large dependency folders, and inspect all generated DOCX and Markdown content. Treat auto-generated function and technical-feature descriptions as drafts, not legal advice, and do not submit anything to the copyright site until a responsible person has verified the source excerpts and filing text.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Reading source files and writing generated registration materials is expected for this skill. The lack of explicit permission metadata is a disclosure/scoping caveat, not evidence of hidden or malicious behavior.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The generic fallback text for functions and technical features is an accuracy risk for legal filing content; the skill requires user review, so this is guidance-level rather than malicious behavior.
